{{Quote|I'll brief everyone on the way to Bormus.|Anakin Skywalker, to his Padawan, as he leaves for the Bormus testing facility|<ref name="TCW:P" />}}
A '''space station''' that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]] was run by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the facility was used to build and test the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] asked [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for permission to use the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] new weapon, the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. However, [[Gender/Legends|his]] request was denied because the fighters needed at least another three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of testing. Skywalker decided to personally travel to the Bormus testing facility&mdash;along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and several of his [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|clone pilots]]&mdash;and obtain the Y-wings himself. After convincing a [[Unidentified Gran worker|Gran]] who worked at the facility to allow him to access the fighters, Skywalker and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were allowed to leave with the Y-wings.

==Description==
The Bormus testing facility was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]], owned and operated by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]], that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]]. The facility was used to build and test several different [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]],<ref name="PH" /> and was equipped with several [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]], which could hold at least twelve [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] and a [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]].<ref name="TCW:P" />

==History==
{{Quote|I need those bombers. It's a Republic emergency.''"<br />"''They&mdash;they are not ready!|Skywalker, asking a Gran worker for the Y-wing bombers|<ref name="TCW:P" />}}
[[File:Gran_worker_Bormus.png|thumb|left|150px|The Gran worker]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Bormus testing facility was used to build and test new [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] for the Republic war effort.<ref name="TCW:P" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 18: Y-wing">{{FactFile2014|18|YWI 3-4|BTL-B Y-wing Starfighter}}</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] asked [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] whether he could use the Y-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] new weapon, the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. However, Skywalker's request was denied because the Y-wings required at least another three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of field-testing before they would be deemed ready for use. Skywalker decided to acquire the Y-wings himself, and traveled to the Bormus testing facility with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|unit]].<ref name="TCW:P" />

When Skywalker's group reached the testing facility, Skywalker and Tano began to speak with a [[Unidentified Gran worker|Gran]] at the facility as [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick]] and [[Broadside/Legends|Broadside]]&mdash;[[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] from Shadow Squadron&mdash;tried to secure the fighters, which were being held in [[Hangar 8122]]. However, when the pilots tried to enter the hangar, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] guarding the Y-wings would not let them pass because the pair didn't have proper authorization. Broadside and Matchstick argued that since they had a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with them, they outranked the guards, and should be allowed to pass. Meanwhile, R2-D2 gave the Gran worker falsified documents that said Skywalker could take the Y-wings. The Gran, however, still did not allow the Jedi access to the Y-wings, as it violated procedure: they were still under production, and the request for the starfighters to be cleared for use needed to come directly from the office of Ask Aak. When Tano threatened to call Palpatine and tell him that their mission had to be postponed because the Gran had delayed their efforts, the worker finally allowed the two Jedi to take a squadron of the starfighters.<ref name="TCW:P" />

==Commanders and crew==
There was at least one Gran working at the testing facility, whose job was to help run the BTL-B Y-wing starfighter program. The facility also had several armed clone trooper guards, who protected the Y-wings.<ref name="TCW:P" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bormus testing facility made its first and only appearance in ''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'', a six-page [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]] which led into "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," an episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

[[Pablo Hidalgo]], the writer of ''Procedure'', intended for the Gran working at the facility to be an example of Senator Ask Aak putting choice beings into places of influence. However, since this was not clarified in ''Procedure'' itself, this plot element is only conjecture.<ref name="PH" />
